# World object (tile) definitions

Every static world object is a tile carrying properties. Across 5 definition files (381,135 lines) the game defines **583 tilesets** and **37,060 tiles**, using **230 distinct properties**.

A tile's identity is `<tileset file>_<index>`, so `advertising_01_0` is index 0 of the `advertising_01` tileset. That string is what `IsoObject:getSprite():getName()` returns and what a sprite lookup takes.

Properties are how a mod decides what an object is: `IsoObject:hasProperty("IsDoor")` and `getProperties():Val("Material")` read exactly these keys. A property absent from this catalogue does not exist on any base-game tile.

**A property with an empty value is a flag**, present or absent — that is the common case here, and it is why so many rows below show an empty value set.
